fields.mechanism: Unbalanced magnetic pull or eccentricity causing excessive eddy current losses and vibration in the rotor structure during no-load operation.
fields.intervention: Perform a runout and air-gap eccentricity inspection on the rotor shaft; if eccentricity is high, re-balance the rotor or re-machine the stator bore to ensure uniform air gap.
fields.expected_effect: Reduction of parasitic eddy currents and mechanical vibration, allowing the motor to operate within thermal limits on no-load.
fields.falsification_test: Measure rotor-to-stator air gap uniformity using an air-gap probe; if the gap is uniform within 5% tolerance and vibration levels are low, this mechanism is disproven.

candidate.expected_effect: Reduction of parasitic eddy currents and mechanical vibration, allowing the motor to operate within thermal limits on no-load.
candidate.falsification_test: Measure rotor-to-stator air gap uniformity using an air-gap probe; if the gap is uniform within 5% tolerance and vibration levels are low, this mechanism is disproven.

fields.mechanism: Thermal equivalent circuit modeling identifies core loss and friction-induced heating as dominant no-load thermal sources when copper losses are minimal due to balanced winding resistance.
fields.intervention: Construct a thermal equivalent circuit model of the motor using measured no-load current, core loss parameters, and bearing friction data to identify whether excessive iron losses or mechanical drag drives the temperature rise above the overload trip threshold.
fields.expected_effect: The thermal model will isolate the specific heat generation node responsible for the 20-minute trip, allowing targeted correction such as bearing replacement or stator lamination repair without altering the verified electrical supply.
fields.falsification_test: Run the motor uncoupled from the conveyor with embedded thermocouples on the stator core and bearings; if neither component approaches the thermal overload trip temperature within 25 minutes, the thermal circuit model's predicted heat source is falsified.
